source_title: Pick of the stats: Sheffield United v Wrexham - BBC
source_excerpt:
Sheffield United and Wrexham kick-off the Championship weekend with a Friday night meeting at Bramall Lane (20:00 GMT).
The Blades have taken seven points from their past four league games and salvaged a 1-1 draw at home to Derby last time out, meaning another three points would take them within a point of the play-off places.
The Red Dragons are winless in their past four away games, scoring only once, and Saturday's 2-0 defeat at Blackburn left them 17th, though just two points behind the Blades.
Sheffield United have won just one of their six league games against Wrexham (D1 L4), a 2-0 home win in October 1982.
